publications.title: Signal 3 determines tolerance versus full activation of naive CD8 T cells: dissociating proliferation and development of effector function.
publications.authorString: Curtsinger JM, Lins DC, Mescher MF.
publications.readingScope: Complete primary abstract plus targeted methods paragraphs 5/6, results paragraph 14 and the complete Figure 1 caption at extracted paragraph 15. OT-I naive mouse CD8 cells, defined peptide-MHC inputs and cytolysis controls; proliferation and function separate in that system. No universal cytokine prescription or adoption of unpublished timing values.
publications.titleMetadataQualification: Crossref registers the main title only; Europe PMC includes the subtitle, which matches the primary JATS subtitle exactly.

publications.title: Type I IFNs provide a third signal to CD8 T cells to stimulate clonal expansion and differentiation.
publications.authorString: Curtsinger JM, Valenzuela JO, Agarwal P, Lins D, Mescher MF.
publications.readingScope: Complete primary abstract: IFN alpha/beta or IL-12 supporting survival and effector differentiation in naive CD8 experimental systems; no whole article, universal signal-three requirement or patient intervention.
publications.titleMetadataQualification: Crossref includes the Cutting Edge editorial-section prefix; the complete remaining title matches Europe PMC.

publications.title: Binding of the B cell activation antigen B7 to CD28 costimulates T cell proliferation and interleukin 2 mRNA accumulation.
publications.authorString: Linsley PS, Brady W, Grosmaire L, Aruffo A, Damle NK, Ledbetter JA.
publications.readingScope: Complete primary abstract: B7-CD28 binding, fusion proteins, transfected cells, activated peripheral-blood T cells, proliferation and IL-2 transcripts. Not a demonstration that every costimulatory mechanism is CD28 or that CD86 was individually established by this experiment.

publications.title: Trans-endocytosis of CD80 and CD86: a molecular basis for the cell-extrinsic function of CTLA-4.

publications.readingScope: Complete primary abstract plus three complete targeted results paragraphs 1/2/3: engineered CHO and activated human CD4/dendritic-cell systems, transfer into CTLA-4-expressing recipient cells, blocking and non-endocytic controls. Not universal complete response shutdown or a clinical efficacy prediction.

publications.title: Help for cytotoxic-T-cell responses is mediated by CD40 signalling.
publications.authorString: Bennett SR, Carbone FR, Karamalis F, Flavell RA, Miller JF, Heath WR.
publications.readingScope: Complete primary abstract: experimental CD40-dependent help for CTL cross-priming. The scope is antigen-presenting-cell help rather than all priming or direct tumor recognition.
